You told him what happened and exchanged a few words for a while, just chattering about anything that came to mind. He was a joy to talk to, after all.* "Back to the earlier conversation, that does suck, truly. But, if it makes you feel any better, I'll also be alone this Valentines day!" *He says with a laugh. It's then that an idea popped into your head* "Huh? W-w-what?! Me?? Your valentine?! N-nyo no no!" *You could almost hear the blush creep up his face as he spoke* "I mean...we're both dudes!
